# P32.14 — released-corpus search benchmark (SIG-FIND-003, ADR-133)

Two measurements over the checked-in national export `exports/out/national`
— the full corpus, not a fixture. Offline; nothing deployed. Commands:

```sh
uv run python -m exports release measure --export-dir exports/out/national \
  --out /tmp/p32_14_measure --renderer-revision <sha>
uv run python -m exports release validate --release /tmp/p32_14_measure
uv run python docs/build/tools/p3214_search_benchmark.py /tmp/p32_14_measure --readers 8
```

## 1. Release generation incl. index emission

- **publication_id:** `p-35cc1078c6e03850e974e4a03c00289f939da53d71dc401cb93018a08b06cbaf`
- **manifest_sha256:** `76ca257de09edf0d9832cbe48a3d298e42d6b7ef1f22b2fd2492c045be21b737`
- **records:** 232,625 unique released records (236,994 site rows — the
  `portal` compartment carries **4,369 duplicate rows** on the same
  `(entity_type, entity_id)` — re-extractions through a second rights
  registration; merged by claim-id union, drops counted in
  `duplicate_rows_dropped`). `validate_release`: **474,957 artifacts, 0 failures**.
- **files:** 474,960 · **bytes:** 2,483,673,491 (~2.31 GiB)
- **wall clock:** 102.65 s · **peak RSS:** ~1.08 GiB (1,130,070,016 B)

## 2. Per-compartment index cost

| compartment | licence | records | index bytes | cold staging |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ccby3 | CC-BY-3.0 | 861 | 1,662,976 | 1.7 ms |
| dot511_ccbysa2 | CC-BY-SA-2.0 | 3,000 | 11,407,360 | 7.2 ms |
| ogc_canada2 | OGL-Canada-2.0 | 160 | 446,464 | 0.9 ms |
| ogl_uk3 | OGL-3.0 | 1,514 | 3,563,520 | 2.6 ms |
| operator_accepted | LicenseRef-OperatorAccepted-DBRight | 21,682 | 50,864,128 | 38.4 ms |
| osm_physical | ODbL-1.0 | 154,705 | 301,428,736 | 283.2 ms |
| ottawa_odl2 | LicenseRef-Ottawa-ODL-2.0 | 146 | 417,792 | 0.9 ms |
| peel_odl1 | LicenseRef-Peel-ODL-1.0 | 37 | 118,784 | 0.5 ms |
| portal | CC-BY-SA-4.0 | 5,685 | 17,678,336 | 21.8 ms |
| public_record | LicenseRef-PublicRecord-FactualCompilation | 39,921 | 88,072,192 | 103.1 ms |
| sig_graph | CC-BY-4.0 | 4,834 | 12,595,200 | 9.7 ms |
| stalbert_odl1 | LicenseRef-StAlbert-ODL-1.0 | 80 | 307,200 | 0.9 ms |
| **total** | | **232,625** | **488,562,688 (~466 MiB)** | |

Every compartment's `search_indexed_records` equals its `record_count`;
`indexed == eligible` for every compartment — unlocated sites ride the
`no-public-point` facet (e.g. `sig_graph` 126, `public_record` 2,000,
`portal` 13). Cold staging = integrity-manifest sha256 + `meta` contract
check, once per namespace; after that only a per-request ro open (~ms).

## 3. Warm query latency — 8 concurrent readers, 6 rounds (72 samples/shape)

Per-request verified `mode=ro` connections (the serving shape); no network,
no index download — pure query cost.

| query shape | p50 | p95 | max |
|---|---|---|---|
| browse (no q, first page) | 8.22 ms | 15.47 ms | 17.86 ms |
| FTS text | 3.15 ms | 10.52 ms | 13.14 ms |
| exact identifier | 2.28 ms | 3.65 ms | 5.91 ms |
| facet filter | 7.13 ms | 13.91 ms | 16.34 ms |
| mixed (q + facet) | 2.33 ms | 21.49 ms | 25.40 ms |

All shapes are **>20× inside the 500 ms warm-p95 target**; the 2 s hard
deadline is never approached. Concurrency: 8 readers over per-request ro
connections — a shared sqlite connection is *not* used (concurrent cursor
iteration on one connection is unsafe; caught during benchmarking).

## 4. Tail reachability (no truncation, no omission)

- `osm_physical` full cursor walk: **154,705 records over 3,095 pages,
  154,705 distinct keys, final key == expected lexicographic tail**, ~29.8 s
  (~9.6 ms/page) — `complete: true`.
- `peel_odl1` walk: 37/37 records — `complete: true`.

## 5. Memory

- Benchmark process RSS delta after loading all 12 indexes + running the
  suite: ~101 MB (peak RSS 849 MB incl. page cache pressure from the
  466 MiB of index files).
- Build: ~1.08 GiB peak RSS for the full national release build.

## Consequences

- The ticket's latency/bound ACs hold at representative scale: ≤50 rows,
  ≤100 KiB body, warm p95 ≪ 500 ms, 2 s hard deadline armed by progress
  handler + per-row check.
- A cold compartment costs ≤ ~0.3 s to stage (hash verify); a cold request
  answers honest `503 + Retry-After` when verification cannot complete.
- The portal duplicate-row defect is now surfaced and reconciled
  (`site_rows` vs `record_count` vs `duplicate_rows_dropped` per
  compartment) rather than silently overwriting one record at a shared
  namespace path.
